lines.en: : I have no idea what that means, but feel free to just forget about everything that’s happened in the last 30 minutes.
lines.zh: : 我不知道那是什么意思，不过过去 30 分钟发生的一切你就尽管忘掉吧。

lines.en: : I don’t play a class that can modify memory, Sir.
lines.zh: : 老师，我玩的职业不会修改记忆。

lines.en: : And even if I did, that’s a fifth level enchantment.
lines.zh: : 就算会，那也是五级附魔。

lines.en: : I’ll just live with shame and regret and go back to only replenishing my mana in the showers.
lines.zh: : 那我就带着羞耻和后悔活着，以后只在洗澡的时候补充法力吧。

lines.en: : Or just, you know, lock your door.
lines.zh: : 或者，你知道的，锁好你的门。

lines.en: scene mollymast27
: I thought I did!
lines.zh: : 我以为我锁了！

lines.en: : I even heard you knocking and intentionally didn’t answer so you’d leave!
lines.zh: : 我甚至听见您敲门了，还故意不应，好让您走开！

lines.en: : So you {i}did{/i} hear me.
lines.zh: : 所以你{i}确实{/i}听见我了。

lines.en: : Yes! You knock very loudly, Sir!
lines.zh: : 对！老师您敲门声可真大！

lines.en: scene mollymast28
: I’ll just use arcane lock from now on. That's what I should have done in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我以后就用奥术锁了。一开始就该这么做的。

lines.en: Yes, Molly. Rely on a magical lock. That’s sure to put an end to my perversion.
lines.zh: 好啊，Molly。靠一把魔法锁。那肯定能终结我的变态行径。

lines.en: : It’s actually kind of weird, Sir.
lines.zh: : 说起来有点怪，老师。

lines.en: : I’ve played a lot of games with scenes where the protagonist walks in on a girl...replenishing her mana...and certain {i}things{/i} always transpire after that.
lines.zh: : 我玩过很多游戏，里面都有主角撞见女生……补充法力……的场面，而之后总会发生{i}某些事{/i}。

lines.en: : But when it actually happened to me, I kicked you in the face and broke all of my ribs.
lines.zh: : 可真轮到我的时候，我一脚踹在您脸上，还把所有肋骨都摔断了。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure your ribs are fine if you’re able to hold a conversation with me.
lines.zh: : 你还能跟我对话，肋骨应该没事。

lines.en: : That may be so, but rollback is disabled in real life and I’ll never know how things {i}should{/i} have played out.
lines.zh: : 也许是吧，可现实生活里没有回滚，我永远都不会知道事情{i}本该{/i}怎么发展。

lines.en: : Stupid teacher, passing through barriers undetected.
lines.zh: : 该死的老师，居然能神不知鬼不觉地穿过结界。

lines.en: : I can’t wait until the devs find out and nerf you.
lines.zh: : 等开发者发现了把您削弱，我就放心了。

lines.en: : Well, I know saying sorry won’t fix anything. But I’m sure we’ll look back on this in time and laugh about it.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我知道说对不起也补救不了什么。但我相信过段时间我们回头看，会笑出来的。

lines.en: : Perhaps if you had {i}only{/i} seen me doing the thing.
lines.zh: : 如果您{i}只是{/i}看到我在做那件事，也许会。

lines.en: : But my reluctance to close certain tabs has led to something that causes grave concern for me.
lines.zh: : 可我没关掉某些标签页，导致了另一件让我非常担忧的事。

lines.en: : So much so that my face is burning up just thinking about it.
lines.zh: : 担忧到光是想想，我的脸就在发烫。

lines.en: : I’m not going to say anything about what I saw, Molly.
lines.zh: : 我不会说出去的，Molly。我看到什么都不会说。

lines.en: : It was just the one time, I swear.
lines.zh: : 就那一次，我发誓。

lines.en: : That’s fi-
lines.zh: : 那没关——

lines.en: : Okay, maybe it was more than one time.
lines.zh: : 好吧，也许不止一次。

lines.en: : Again, that’s-
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，那没——

lines.en: scene mollymast29
: AAAAAH FINE! I DO IT ALL THE TIME!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊好吧！我一直都在做！

lines.en: : SHE’S SO PRETTY AND...
lines.zh: : 她那么漂亮，而且……

lines.en: : AND PERFECT...AND...
lines.zh: : 而且完美……而且……

lines.en: : AND-
lines.zh: : 而且——

lines.en: scene mollymast30
: And...she won’t even {i}look{/i} at me.
lines.zh: : 而且……她连{i}看{/i}都不看我一眼。

lines.en: Uh-oh.
lines.zh: 哎哟。

lines.en: I didn’t expect to get into this right now.
lines.zh: 我没想到现在会聊到这个。

lines.en: : She didn’t talk to me for a whole week after the Christmas party, Sir.
lines.zh: : 圣诞派对之后，她整整一个星期没跟我说话，老师。

lines.en: : Am I that horrible?
lines.zh: : 我就那么糟糕吗？

lines.en: : Is kissing me truly the worst thing in the entire world?
lines.zh: : 跟我接吻真的是这世界上最可怕的事吗？

lines.en: scene mollymast31
: And then...and then to top it all off, she went back to treating everything like normal right afterwards.
lines.zh: : 然后……然后最要命的是，她事后马上就把一切当成了平常。

lines.en: : Like it never even happened.
lines.zh: : 就像什么都没发生过一样。

lines.en: : How is that fair?
lines.zh: : 这算什么公平？

lines.en: : Sure, it seemed like a joke at the time...but there was always the hope that maybe she’d notice me after that.
lines.zh: : 当然，那时候看起来像是个玩笑……可我一直抱着一丝希望，觉得也许那之后她会注意到我。

lines.en: scene mollymast32
: Of course not, though. I mean-
lines.zh: : 当然没有。我是说——

lines.en: : I’m Molly MacCormack.
lines.zh: : 我是 Molly MacCormack。

lines.en: : The Emerald Guardian of the Crystal Forest.
lines.zh: : 水晶森林的翡翠守护者。

lines.en: : A fully geared resto druid with every single “Ahead of the Curve” achievement.
lines.zh: : 一个装备齐全的恢复德，拿遍了所有「千钧一发」成就。

lines.en: : And a girl who has no use for actual human beings since they have no use for her!
lines.zh: : 还是一个对真实的人类毫无用处的女生，因为真实的人类对她也毫无用处！

lines.en: : I don’t need anyone! I’m independent!
lines.zh: : 我不需要任何人！我很独立！

lines.en: : I can do anything! Go anywhere!
lines.zh: : 我什么都能做到！哪儿都去得了！

lines.en: scene mollymast33
: I can...
lines.zh: : 我可以……

lines.en: : I can-
lines.zh: : 我可以——

lines.en: : Okay, okay. Come here.
lines.zh: : 好了好了。过来。

lines.en: scene mollymast34
: AAAAAAAAAAHHHH!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

lines.en: : I HATE THIS SO MUCH! THIS IS EXACTLY WHY I PREFER 2D!
lines.zh: : 我恨死这样了！所以我才更喜欢 2D！

lines.en: scene mollymast35
Molly lunges forward and buries her head into my chest.
lines.zh: Molly 猛地扑过来，把头埋进我的胸口。

lines.en: It’s only a matter of seconds before I can feel her tears beginning to seep through my shirt.
lines.zh: 不过几秒钟，我就感觉到她的眼泪开始渗进我的衬衫。

lines.en: Life is weird.
lines.zh: 人生真奇怪。

lines.en: I started tonight by walking into her room uninvited, catching her in the act of pleasuring herself-
lines.zh: 今晚我是不请自来走进她的房间，撞见她在取悦自己——

lines.en: And now she’s crying and confessing feelings that I’m sure she wanted to keep locked away for as long as possible.
lines.zh: 而现在她在哭，在倾诉那些我敢肯定她想藏得越久越好的感情。

lines.en: I guess being a degenerate pays off sometimes.
lines.zh: 我猜当废柴偶尔也会有回报。

lines.en: scene black

I let Molly cry for another minute or two, rubbing her bright orange hair and standing still, hoping none of the other girls on this floor come out and catch us in the middle of a strangely sentimental moment.
lines.zh: 我让 Molly 又哭了一两分钟，揉着她那头亮橙色的头发，站着不动，盼着这层楼其他的女生都别出来撞见我们这莫名感人的一幕。

lines.en: A strangely sentimental moment that only exists because I couldn't mind my own business.
lines.zh: 而这莫名感人的一幕之所以存在，只是因为我没能管好我自己的事。

lines.en: What a time to be alive.
lines.zh: 活着可真是时候啊。

lines.en: Molly goes back to normal eventually and retreats back into her dorm.
lines.zh: Molly 最终恢复了正常，退回了自己的宿舍。

lines.en: I need to assure her a few more times that I won’t say anything and, it takes a while, but I’m pretty sure she eventually believes me.
lines.zh: 我得再向她保证好几次我不会说出去，虽然花了点时间，但我敢说她最后相信了我。

lines.en: But now I can’t help but wonder if anything more will ever come of this.
lines.zh: 可现在我不禁在想，这件事之后还会不会再有什么下文。

lines.en: if rinkiss == True:
Especially now that...{i}something{/i} is going on between Rin and me.
lines.zh: 尤其是现在……我和 Rin 之间有点{i}什么{/i}。

lines.en: What that something is, I have no idea.
lines.zh: 那到底是什么，我也不知道。

lines.en: But I hope that whatever it is, Molly will understand.
lines.zh: 但我希望不管是什么，Molly 都能理解。

lines.en: else:
Rin’s been searching for love since the moment I met her.
lines.zh: Rin 从我认识她的那一刻起就在寻找爱。

lines.en: But I guess that even someone who {i}seems{/i} like a perfect match for her isn’t someone she should automatically just...want to be with.
lines.zh: 可我想，即便是{i}看起来{/i}跟她完美契合的人，她也不该自动就……想要跟对方在一起。

lines.en: Molly clearly has some feelings she needs to sort out- and so does Rin.
lines.zh: Molly 显然有一些需要理清的感情——Rin 也是。

lines.en: So does everybody.
lines.zh: 每个人都是。

lines.en: Until then, though-
lines.zh: 不过在那之前——

lines.en: I guess I’ll just keep sneaking into girls' rooms and watching them finger themselves.
lines.zh: 我猜我还会继续溜进女生房间，看她们用手指弄自己。

lines.en: Just kidding.
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。

lines.en: I’ll obviously be there for Molly if she ever needs another shirt to cry into.
lines.zh: 显然，要是 Molly 还需要一件可以哭湿的衬衫，我会一直在。

lines.en: And next time, I won’t open the door if she doesn’t answer.
lines.zh: 而下次，如果她不应门，我就不会开门了。

lines.en: $ molly_love += 1
$ mollydorm20 = True
{i}Molly’s affection has increased to [molly_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Molly 的好感度提升到了 [molly_love]!{/i}
